name: Broccoli rabe (Rapini)

schedule.notes: Bolts hot — spring harvest must be in by early summer. Or skip spring and run a fall crop.
Fall is the better season — cool nights are essential for tender, mild flowers.
Cut whole plant or 6-in shoots when flower buds form but before they fully open. Yellow flowers = past prime.

harvest.cues: Slender stems with leaves and tight flower buds. Some open yellow flowers OK; mostly-open is too late.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge wrapped in damp paper 3 to 5 days. Sauté with garlic and olive oil — the classic Italian preparation.

varieties.name: Spring Raab
varieties.notes: Fastest to maturity. Best for narrow spring window.

varieties.name: Sessantina Grossa
varieties.notes: Italian heirloom. More leaves, larger plants. Best for fall.

notes: Not actually a broccoli — a turnip relative grown for flower buds. Strong, peppery, slightly bitter. Blanch 1 minute before sautéing if the bitterness is too much.
